verdicts.reason: A: the body copy is pulled away from the headline into a cramped three-line block at the far left over a clipped circle, so the banner reads body first. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, and the badges are squeezed around the tiny can with no clear grouping. B: the CTA and both badges are crammed into a stacked left column, so the eye hits the button before the headline, and the body copy is close to illegible. Still, B keeps headline, brand and copy together as one block with the can on the right, which makes it the less broken of the two.
